llm.summary: This skill is a real Superagnt/Instantly API integration, but it exposes powerful workspace administration, credential, billing, and destructive account operations beyond ordinary outreach workflows.

dimensions.detail: Using SUPERAGNT_API_KEY and connected Instantly credentials is expected for this integration, but the resulting authority is much broader than campaign execution and includes sensitive mailbox credentials, email content, lead data, billing data, and workspace administration.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is documented as either connecting the Superagnt MCP server or using curl with SUPERAGNT_API_KEY; no bundled executable scripts or local install hooks were found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The endpoint list is explicit, but the skill gives broad raw API access with many POST/PATCH/DELETE operations and no safety section or confirmation guidance for destructive, credential, ownership, or membership changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence or backdoor behavior was found, but the skill can create API keys, configure webhooks, manage workspace members, and change workspace ownership, which are high-impact persistent account-side changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is cold email campaign, lead, analytics, and account-setting management, but the artifact also documents API key creation/deletion, billing/subscription reads, workspace member and group administration, workspace domain changes, and workspace ownership transfer.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Use it only in a workspace where the agent is allowed to administer Instantly, not just manage campaigns. Treat API key creation/deletion, workspace membership changes, ownership transfer, webhook setup, mailbox password handling, email actions, and bulk delete operations as requiring explicit human approval.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Verified in the artifact: the documented capability surface goes beyond the outreach-focused description into billing, API key, workspace membership, and ownership operations.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Verified in the artifact: API key lifecycle, workspace member/group management, billing reads, and workspace owner transfer are present and are not ordinary outreach campaign operations.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Verified in the artifact: many destructive and sensitive operations are documented, but the skill does not provide cautions, approval guidance, or scoped default workflows.
[E1] expected: The external Superagnt API URL is expected for a Superagnt unified API integration and is disclosed; this was not treated as exfiltration by itself.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The supplied A.I.G SARIF run reported no results, which is consistent with the absence of bundled executable code or hidden prompt-injection text in the inspected artifact.
